speaker: Leonard
text: I'm Jim. Well, I'd like to point out, I voted for orangutans, but you shouted me down. Uh, hi Betty. I'm, uh, at work.

speaker: Penny
text: Hey, where are you? You sound funny.

speaker: Leonard
text: Uh, I'm, I'm, I'm in a radiation suit. What's up?

speaker: Penny
text: No, I'm at work too, and you'll never guess who's here infecting my entire station.

speaker: Leonard
text: Jughead's at the Cheesecake Factory. It's time to go home.

speaker: Penny
text: It won't be, because he's afraid he'll pass out on the bus and someone will harvest his organs.

speaker: Leonard
text: He's paranoid and he's established a nest.

speaker: Penny
text: Can you please come get him?

speaker: Leonard
text: Uh, yeah, I'd, I'd be happy to, Betty. Oh my god, there's a breach in the radiation unit. Someone send me the tech. Oh my god, the crystal. No, no, it's gotta go by.

speaker: Leonard
text: I feel really guilty. You did what you had to do. Take your stinking paws off my popcorn, you damn dirty ape.
